name: Invoke the Fourth Wall, Break the Game
description_md:
```
Player Type: Spike
Main Player Counts: 1, 2
Can Do: 1, 2, 3, 4
Key Cards: Stick-To-Itiveness, Healing Factor
```
Playthroughs:
- [Longship Gaming](https://youtu.be/Lhe6yIZz7wE?si=4ojzQITSumnvst_M)

Ever thought to your self, “I want to like Dr. Strange, but he’s just not strong enough”? Just make Dr. Strange a ‘Pool, and now he can finally be strong enough to really break the game.

Resolve a couple of invocations, then use [Mulligan](/card/44048) to draw a new hand.

Use [Get Rage-y](/card/44020) to ready [Wong](/card/09002) so you can get to the right invocation.

[Stick-To-Itiveness](/card/44030) will give you another ready to play another invocation.

[Machine Man](/card/26022) will let you use up any extra resources to get a good activation.

Enjoy a Dr. Strange who breaks a game even more.
